title: Synthesis, Characterization, and Properties of Three Europium 2-Propoxides: [Eu4(OPrᶦ)10(HOPrᶦ)3]·2HOPrᶦ, Eu5O(OPrᶦ)13, and EuAl3(OPrᶦ)12

synthesis.procedure: Eu metal and a small amount of HgCl2 catalyst were added to a 1:1 toluene/2-propanol mixture under dry conditions. The mixture was heated at 65–70 °C for 24 h to dissolve the metal. The dark-yellow solution was separated from a small residue and slowly evaporated to give orange-yellow crystals. Larger crystals were obtained by redissolving the product in 2-propanol and evaporating very slowly. The paper reports that the same product also forms without the Hg catalyst.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Metal dissolution in a closed vessel under dried nitrogen; other preparation operations under dry, oxygen-free argon
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Separate the solution from residual black powder; slowly evaporate. For larger crystals, dissolve in 2-propanol and evaporate very slowly.

properties.summary: A strong absorption band extending from the UV to approximately 550–600 nm accompanies weaker Eu(III) f–f absorptions. The article reports electronic absorption spectra, not emission measurements.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The discrete Eu4 core has a butterfly conformation with two Eu(III) hinge atoms and two Eu(II) wingtip atoms. A central μ4-2-propoxo oxygen connects all four Eu atoms; additional μ3- and μ2-2-propoxo bridges complete the core. In the crystal, hydrogen bonds involving 2-propanol link the tetranuclear units into strands.

synthesis.procedure: K was dissolved in 1:1 toluene/2-propanol, followed by addition of a 1 M water solution in toluene/2-propanol for stoichiometric hydrolysis. Anhydrous EuCl3 was then added. After 48 h at room temperature, precipitated KCl was removed by centrifugation. The solution was evaporated to dryness, redissolved in just enough toluene, and slowly evaporated to crystallize the product. Preparations were carried out under dry, oxygen-free argon.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Metathesis with stoichiometric hydrolysis under dry, oxygen-free argon
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Centrifuge to remove KCl; evaporate the solution to dryness, dissolve in a minimal amount of toluene, and slowly evaporate.

properties.summary: Weak Eu(III) f–f absorption peaks are observed. Their similar shapes and positions in solid and solution spectra support retention of the molecular structure upon dissolution; emission was not reported.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Five trivalent Eu atoms form a nearly regular square pyramid. The μ5-oxo atom lies 0.22(2) Å above the basal plane; each Eu is six-coordinate to oxygen.

synthesis.procedure: K was dissolved in 1:2 toluene/2-propanol, then Al(OPrᶦ)3 was added to form the potassium aluminium alkoxide reagent in situ. EuCl3 was added two hours later. After a further 48 h at room temperature, KCl was removed by centrifugation. The solution was evaporated to dryness, redissolved in just enough toluene, and slowly evaporated. The resulting crystals were washed with a small amount of 2-propanol. Preparations were carried out under dry, oxygen-free argon.
synthesis.time: 2 h before EuCl3 addition; a further 48 h afterward
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Metathesis using potassium aluminium 2-propoxide formed in situ, under dry, oxygen-free argon
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Centrifuge to remove KCl; evaporate to dryness, dissolve in minimal toluene, slowly evaporate, and wash the off-white crystals with a small amount of 2-propanol.

properties.summary: Electronic absorption spectra were recorded for the solid and solutions. The solid and hexane-solution spectra are similar, whereas a 2-propanol-containing solution shows intensity changes that the authors discuss as a possible weak solvent interaction. Emission was not reported.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The molecular EuAl3 framework has Eu connected to three Al atoms through μ2-2-propoxo oxygen bridges. Eu has a twisted-octahedral oxygen coordination environment, while each Al has a distorted tetrahedral oxygen coordination sphere that includes two terminal 2-propoxo groups.
